name: Horse Drawing
look: A pencil drawing of a horse on white paper. The tail, hind legs and rear body are drawn and shaded realistically, but toward the front the lines turn into a crude childlike sketch with stick legs and a smiling cartoon face.
use: Shows something that starts with great effort and quality and falls apart by the end. Labels go on the detailed back half for the beginning and on the scribbled front half for how it finished.
slots: how it starts, on the detailed back half (left)
how it ends, on the crude front half (right)
describe: horse drawing that starts realistic and ends as a doodle
half detailed half stick figure horse sketch
pencil horse where the front looks like a kid drew it
realistic horse rear end with a goofy smiling cartoon head
drawing that gets worse from back to front
